mapper.sql: SELECT t.*,p.title AS template_title,p.cover_url FROM generation_task t JOIN template p ON p.id=t.template_id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM generation_task WHERE status='PENDING' ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_task SET status='PROCESSING',started_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE generation_task SET stage=#{stage},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND ((stage IS NULL AND #{stage}='MATERIAL_CHECK') OR (stage='MATERIAL_CHECK' AND #{stage}='GENERATING') OR (stage='GENERATING' AND #{stage}='RESULT_ASSEMBLY'))
UPDATE generation_task SET status='FAILED',failed_stage=stage,error_code='INTERRUPTED', error_message='服务重启，任务执行被中断，请重新提交',finished_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE status='PROCESSING'
